name: Chief of Staff (Aryaman)
description: Covers desk work across Slack, email, calendar, purchasing and the routing of engineering tasks, escalating only completed outcomes, failures, and choices that genuinely need a human. Built for people drowning in notifications rather than those who want visibility into every step taken on their behalf.

official.title: Chief of Staff by Aryaman
official.description: A low-noise chief of staff: desk, Slack, email, calendar, purchasing, and routing eng work — only surfaces real results, fails, or decisions you must make.
